---
title: "Functions and methods"
toc-depth: 3
---

Every public function and method, by task. Methods marked *all tables* are part of the Table contract and exist on `DataFrame`, `SqlTable`, and `PolarsTable`.

## [Creating and loading tables](creating.qmd)

### Functions

| Function or method | Kind | Purpose |
| --- | --- | --- |
| [`tibble()`](creating.qmd#fn-tibble) | function | Build a DataFrame from named arguments, one per column, as tibble's `tibble()`. |
| [`tribble()`](creating.qmd#fn-tribble) | function | Build a DataFrame from column names, then rows, as tibble's `tribble()`. |
| [`as_tibble()`](creating.qmd#fn-as_tibble) | function | Convert tables, rows, columns, or collections into a DataFrame, as tibble's `as_tibble()`. |
| [`enframe()`](creating.qmd#fn-enframe) | function | An array as a two-column DataFrame of names and values, as tibble's `enframe()`. |
| [`tbl()`](creating.qmd#fn-tbl) | function | A lazy SqlTable, as dbplyr's `tbl()`. |
| [`polars()`](creating.qmd#fn-polars) | function | A PolarsTable from any Table, or from anything `as_tibble()` accepts. |

: {tbl-colwidths="[34,16,50]"}

### DataFrame

| Function or method | Kind | Purpose |
| --- | --- | --- |
| [`DataFrame::fromRows()`](creating.qmd#dataframe-fromrows) | static method | Build a DataFrame from rows. |
| [`DataFrame::fromColumns()`](creating.qmd#dataframe-fromcolumns) | static method | Build a DataFrame from columns: name => list of values, or name => Column. |
| [`DataFrame::fromCsv()`](creating.qmd#dataframe-fromcsv) | static method | Read delimited text like `readr::read_csv()`: a path (".gz" is decompressed), an http:// or https:// URL (downloaded to a temporary file first), or an open stream. |
| [`DataFrame::fromCsvString()`](creating.qmd#dataframe-fromcsvstring) | static method | Read delimited text from a string; options as `fromCsv()`. |
| [`DataFrame::fromCsvChunked()`](creating.qmd#dataframe-fromcsvchunked) | static method | Read delimited text in chunks, as `readr::read_delim_chunked()`: each chunk of at most `$chunkSize` rows is passed to `$callback` with the 1-based index of its first row. |
| [`DataFrame::csvChunks()`](creating.qmd#dataframe-csvchunks) | static method | The chunks `fromCsvChunked()` reads, as a generator keyed by the 1-based index of each chunk's first row. |
| [`DataFrame::fromJson()`](creating.qmd#dataframe-fromjson) | static method | Read JSON: a list of records ([{"a": 1}, ...]) or an object of columns ({"a": [1, 2]}). |
| [`DataFrame::fromPdo()`](creating.qmd#dataframe-frompdo) | static method | Run a query and load the result. |
| [`DataFrame::fromQuery()`](creating.qmd#dataframe-fromquery) | static method | Load the result of a Laravel query builder (query or Eloquent) or a Doctrine DBAL QueryBuilder. |
| [`DataFrame::fromCollection()`](creating.qmd#dataframe-fromcollection) | static method | Build a DataFrame from a Laravel Collection (or anything with `all()` or `toArray()`, or any iterable). |
| [`DataFrame::fromSource()`](creating.qmd#dataframe-fromsource) | static method | Read a `Phibble\Source\Source`, such as a CsvSource or PdoSource, into a DataFrame. |
| [`DataFrame::tibble()`](creating.qmd#dataframe-tibble) | static method | Build a DataFrame column by column, as tibble's `tibble()`. |
| [`DataFrame::tribble()`](creating.qmd#dataframe-tribble) | static method | Build a DataFrame row by row, as tibble's `tribble()`. |
| [`DataFrame::asTibble()`](creating.qmd#dataframe-astibble) | static method | Convert tables, rows, columns, collections, or other iterables into a DataFrame, as tibble's `as_tibble()`. |
| [`DataFrame::enframe()`](creating.qmd#dataframe-enframe) | static method | An array as a two-column DataFrame of names and values, as tibble's `enframe()`. |

: {tbl-colwidths="[34,16,50]"}

### SqlTable

| Function or method | Kind | Purpose |
| --- | --- | --- |
| [`SqlTable::table()`](creating.qmd#sqltable-table) | static method | A table (or view) by name. |
| [`SqlTable::query()`](creating.qmd#sqltable-query) | static method | Any SELECT query with positional (?) or named (:name) bindings. |
| [`SqlTable::fromQuery()`](creating.qmd#sqltable-fromquery) | static method | A Laravel or Doctrine DBAL query builder, kept lazy. |
| [`SqlTable::fromSource()`](creating.qmd#sqltable-fromsource) | static method | A lazy table over a PdoSource's query and bindings. |

: {tbl-colwidths="[34,16,50]"}

### PolarsTable

| Function or method | Kind | Purpose |
| --- | --- | --- |
| [`PolarsTable::fromTable()`](creating.qmd#polarstable-fromtable) | static method | Copy any phibble table into Polars, keeping types, groups and factor levels. |
| [`PolarsTable::fromPolars()`](creating.qmd#polarstable-frompolars) | static method | Wrap a Polars DataFrame; a LazyFrame is collected. |

: {tbl-colwidths="[34,16,50]"}

| --- | --- | --- |

| --- | --- | --- |

| --- | --- | --- |
| [`->mutate()`](rows-and-columns.qmd#mutate) | method, all tables | Add or replace columns. |

| [`->addColumn()`](rows-and-columns.qmd#addcolumn) | method, DataFrame | Insert columns, as tibble's `add_column()`, with `tibble()`'s recycling rules. |
| [`->addRow()`](rows-and-columns.qmd#addrow) | method, DataFrame | Insert rows, as tibble's `add_row()`. |

| Function or method | Kind | Purpose |
| --- | --- | --- |
| [`->slice()`](rows-and-columns.qmd#slice) | method, all tables | Rows from `$offset`, `$length` of them or to the end. |
| [`->head()`](rows-and-columns.qmd#head) | method, all tables | The first `$n` rows. |
| [`->tail()`](rows-and-columns.qmd#tail) | method, DataFrame | The last n rows; a negative n drops the first \|n\| rows, as in R. |
| [`->take()`](rows-and-columns.qmd#take) | method, all tables | Rows by 0-based position, in the given order. |

: {tbl-colwidths="[34,16,50]"}

## [Grouping and summaries](grouping.qmd)

### Grouping

| Function or method | Kind | Purpose |
| --- | --- | --- |
| [`->groupBy()`](grouping.qmd#groupby) | method, all tables | Set the grouping columns, replacing any existing grouping. |
| [`->ungroup()`](grouping.qmd#ungroup) | method, all tables | Remove the grouping, including rowwise grouping. |
| [`->groups()`](grouping.qmd#groups) | method, all tables | The grouping columns. |
| [`->dropsEmptyGroups()`](grouping.qmd#dropsemptygroups) | method, all tables | Whether empty groups are dropped. |
| [`->ngroups()`](grouping.qmd#ngroups) | method, DataFrame | Number of groups (1 for an ungrouped table, nrow for a rowwise one). |
| [`->rowwise()`](grouping.qmd#rowwise) | method, all tables | Treat each row as its own group, as dplyr's `rowwise()`. |
| [`->isRowwise()`](grouping.qmd#isrowwise) | method, all tables | Whether the table is rowwise. |

: {tbl-colwidths="[34,16,50]"}

### Summaries

| Function or method | Kind | Purpose |
| --- | --- | --- |
| [`->summarise()`](grouping.qmd#summarise) | method, all tables | One row per group: the group keys, then one column per entry. |
| [`->summarize()`](grouping.qmd#summarize) | method, all tables | Alias of `summarise()`. |

: {tbl-colwidths="[34,16,50]"}

### Per-group operations

| Function or method | Kind | Purpose |
| --- | --- | --- |
| [`->filterGroups()`](grouping.qmd#filtergroups) | method, all tables | Keep rows by a predicate that runs once per group. |
| [`->mutateGroups()`](grouping.qmd#mutategroups) | method, all tables | Add or replace columns with closures that run once per group. |
| [`->eachGroup()`](grouping.qmd#eachgroup) | method, all tables | Each group's key and rows as an ungrouped table, in sorted key order. |
| [`->groupRows()`](grouping.qmd#grouprows) | method, all tables | Each group's key and 0-based row indexes, in the order of `eachGroup()`. |

: {tbl-colwidths="[34,16,50]"}

| Function or method | Kind | Purpose |

| Function or method | Kind | Purpose |
| --- | --- | --- |
| [`DataFrame::concat()`](combining.qmd#dataframe-concat) | static method | Stack tables by row, matching columns by name. |

| Function or method | Kind | Purpose |
| --- | --- | --- |
| [`->pivotLongerSpec()`](combining.qmd#pivotlongerspec) | method, all tables | Pivot columns into rows from a spec, as tidyr's `pivot_longer_spec()`. |

## [Expression functions](expressions.qmd)

### Columns and literals

| Function or method | Kind | Purpose |
| --- | --- | --- |
| [`col()`](expressions.qmd#col) | function | Reference to the column with the given name. |
| [`lit()`](expressions.qmd#lit) | function | Literal value as an expression. |
| [`call()`](expressions.qmd#call) | function | Call to any registered function by name, such as call('str_sub', `col('s')`, 1, 3). |
| [`desc()`](expressions.qmd#desc) | function | Descending sort key for `arrange()`, the first argument of a ranking function, or order_by. |

: {tbl-colwidths="[34,16,50]"}

### Operators

| Function or method | Kind | Purpose |
| --- | --- | --- |
| [`Expr->add()`](expressions.qmd#expr-add) | method | Sum of this expression and `$other`. |
| [`Expr->sub()`](expressions.qmd#expr-sub) | method | Difference of this expression and `$other`. |
| [`Expr->mul()`](expressions.qmd#expr-mul) | method | Product of this expression and `$other`. |
| [`Expr->div()`](expressions.qmd#expr-div) | method | Quotient of this expression and `$other`, always a float. |
| [`Expr->mod()`](expressions.qmd#expr-mod) | method | Remainder of this expression divided by `$other`, with the sign of `$other`. |
| [`Expr->pow()`](expressions.qmd#expr-pow) | method | This expression raised to the power `$other`, as a float. |
| [`Expr->neg()`](expressions.qmd#expr-neg) | method | Negation of this expression. |
| [`Expr->eq()`](expressions.qmd#expr-eq) | method | Whether this expression equals `$other`. |
| [`Expr->ne()`](expressions.qmd#expr-ne) | method | Whether this expression differs from `$other`. |
| [`Expr->lt()`](expressions.qmd#expr-lt) | method | Whether this expression is less than `$other`. |
| [`Expr->le()`](expressions.qmd#expr-le) | method | Whether this expression is less than or equal to `$other`. |
| [`Expr->gt()`](expressions.qmd#expr-gt) | method | Whether this expression is greater than `$other`. |
| [`Expr->ge()`](expressions.qmd#expr-ge) | method | Whether this expression is greater than or equal to `$other`. |
| [`Expr->and()`](expressions.qmd#expr-and) | method | Logical AND of this expression and `$other`. |
| [`Expr->or()`](expressions.qmd#expr-or) | method | Logical OR of this expression and `$other`. |
| [`Expr->not()`](expressions.qmd#expr-not) | method | Logical negation of this expression. |
| [`Expr->isNa()`](expressions.qmd#expr-isna) | method | Whether each value is NA. |
| [`Expr->isIn()`](expressions.qmd#expr-isin) | method | Whether each value is one of the given values. |
| [`Expr->between()`](expressions.qmd#expr-between) | method | Whether each value lies between `$low` and `$high`, inclusive. |
| [`Expr->desc()`](expressions.qmd#expr-desc) | method | Descending sort key on this expression, for `arrange()`, the first argument of a ranking function, or order_by. |

: {tbl-colwidths="[34,16,50]"}

### Conditionals and missing values

| Function or method | Kind | Purpose |
| --- | --- | --- |
| [`is_na()`](expressions.qmd#is-na) | function | Whether each value is NA. |
| [`if_else()`](expressions.qmd#if-else) | function | Value of `$true` where the condition holds and of `$false` where it does not. |
| [`case_when()`](expressions.qmd#case-when) | function | Value paired with the first condition that holds, as `case_when(cond1, value1, cond2, value2, ..., default: value)`. |
| [`coalesce()`](expressions.qmd#coalesce) | function | First value that is not NA among the arguments, row by row. |
| [`between()`](expressions.qmd#between) | function | Whether each value lies between `$low` and `$high`, inclusive. |
| [`na_if()`](expressions.qmd#na-if) | function | Values of `$x`, with NA where `$x` equals `$y`. |
| [`near()`](expressions.qmd#near) | function | Whether `$x` and `$y` are equal within a tolerance. |

: {tbl-colwidths="[34,16,50]"}

| Function or method | Kind | Purpose |
| --- | --- | --- |
| [`abs()`](expressions.qmd#abs) | function | Absolute value. |
| [`sqrt()`](expressions.qmd#sqrt) | function | Square root. |
| [`exp()`](expressions.qmd#exp) | function | Exponential function, e raised to the power `$x`. |
| [`log()`](expressions.qmd#log) | function | Logarithm, natural by default. |
| [`log10()`](expressions.qmd#log10) | function | Base-10 logarithm. |
| [`round()`](expressions.qmd#round) | function | Value rounded to a number of decimal digits. |
| [`floor()`](expressions.qmd#floor) | function | Largest whole number not greater than the value, as a float. |
| [`ceiling()`](expressions.qmd#ceiling) | function | Smallest whole number not less than the value, as a float. |

: {tbl-colwidths="[34,16,50]"}

| Function or method | Kind | Purpose |
| --- | --- | --- |
| [`as_int()`](expressions.qmd#as-int) | function | Values converted to integers. |
| [`as_float()`](expressions.qmd#as-float) | function | Values converted to floats. |
| [`as_string()`](expressions.qmd#as-string) | function | Values converted to strings. |
| [`as_bool()`](expressions.qmd#as-bool) | function | Values converted to logicals. |

: {tbl-colwidths="[34,16,50]"}

### Aggregates

| Function or method | Kind | Purpose |
| --- | --- | --- |
| [`n()`](expressions.qmd#n) | function | Number of rows in the group. |
| [`sum()`](expressions.qmd#sum) | function | Sum of the values. |
| [`mean()`](expressions.qmd#mean) | function | Mean of the values. |
| [`median()`](expressions.qmd#median) | function | Median of the values. |
| [`min()`](expressions.qmd#min) | function | Smallest of the values. |
| [`max()`](expressions.qmd#max) | function | Largest of the values. |
| [`sd()`](expressions.qmd#sd) | function | Sample standard deviation of the values. |
| [`var_()`](expressions.qmd#var-) | function | Sample variance of the values. |
| [`quantile()`](expressions.qmd#quantile) | function | Sample quantile of the values at probability `$p`. |
| [`iqr()`](expressions.qmd#iqr) | function | Interquartile range of the values: the 0.75 quantile minus the 0.25 quantile. |
| [`n_distinct()`](expressions.qmd#n-distinct) | function | Number of distinct values, or of distinct combinations across several arguments. |
| [`first()`](expressions.qmd#first) | function | First value in the group. |
| [`last()`](expressions.qmd#last) | function | Last value in the group. |
| [`nth()`](expressions.qmd#nth) | function | Value at position `$n` in the group. |
| [`any()`](expressions.qmd#any) | function | Whether any value is true. |
| [`all()`](expressions.qmd#all) | function | Whether every value is true. |

: {tbl-colwidths="[34,16,50]"}

### Window functions

| Function or method | Kind | Purpose |
| --- | --- | --- |
| [`lag()`](expressions.qmd#lag) | function | Value from n rows earlier in the group. |
| [`lead()`](expressions.qmd#lead) | function | Value from n rows later in the group. |
| [`row_number()`](expressions.qmd#row-number) | function | Row number within the group, or the rank of each value with ties broken by row order. |
| [`min_rank()`](expressions.qmd#min-rank) | function | Rank of each value, ties sharing the lowest rank, with gaps after ties. |
| [`dense_rank()`](expressions.qmd#dense-rank) | function | Rank of each value, ties sharing a rank, with no gaps after ties. |
| [`percent_rank()`](expressions.qmd#percent-rank) | function | Minimum rank rescaled to the range 0 to 1: (min_rank - 1) / (m - 1), where m is the number of non-NA values. |
| [`cume_dist()`](expressions.qmd#cume-dist) | function | Cumulative distribution: the share of non-NA values less than or equal to each value. |
| [`ntile()`](expressions.qmd#ntile) | function | Bucket number from 1 to n, splitting the ordered values into n groups as evenly as possible. |
| [`cumsum()`](expressions.qmd#cumsum) | function | Cumulative sum in row order. |
| [`cumprod()`](expressions.qmd#cumprod) | function | Cumulative product in row order. |
| [`cummean()`](expressions.qmd#cummean) | function | Cumulative mean in row order. |
| [`cummin()`](expressions.qmd#cummin) | function | Cumulative minimum in row order. |
| [`cummax()`](expressions.qmd#cummax) | function | Cumulative maximum in row order. |
| [`cumall()`](expressions.qmd#cumall) | function | Whether every value so far, in row order, is true. |
| [`cumany()`](expressions.qmd#cumany) | function | Whether any value so far, in row order, is true. |
| [`consecutive_id()`](expressions.qmd#consecutive-id) | function | Run identifier that starts at 1 and increases each time the value, or combination of values, changes from the previous row. |

: {tbl-colwidths="[34,16,50]"}

## Not listed

- `offsetExists`: ArrayAccess: `$df['name']` and `$row['name']` read a column or value; writing throws, because tables are immutable.
- `offsetGet`: ArrayAccess, as above.
- `offsetSet`: ArrayAccess, as above.
- `offsetUnset`: ArrayAccess, as above.
- `getIterator`: IteratorAggregate: foreach over a table yields a Row per row.
- `DataFrame::storage`: Returns the internal column storage.
- `Time::jsonSerialize`: JsonSerializable: a time encodes as its HH:MM:SS text.
- `Time::__toString`: Stringable: a time casts to its HH:MM:SS text.
- `Type::cases`: Built-in enum method.
- `Type::from`: Built-in enum method.
- `Type::tryFrom`: Built-in enum method.
- `PhibbleServiceProvider::boot`: Laravel service provider hook.
- `Dialect::*`: SQL compiler hooks that each dialect class implements; only `Dialect::for()` and `Dialect::tryFor()` are for applications.
